newsitem.title: CANADA: William says hits record production in Q2.
newsitem.headline: William says hits record production in Q2.

text.p: William Resources Inc said on Thursday that operational improvements helped it lift gold production to record levels in the year's second quarter.
William said second-quarter production rose to a record 54,416 ounces of gold compared to 47,319 ounces in the first quarter and 10,050 ounces in the first quarter last year.
William said the results brought production in the first half of the year to 101,807 ounces.
Cash costs fell to about US$278 per ounce for the second quarter, compared to US$410 an ounce in the first quarter last year and US$285 an ounce in the first six months of 1997.
William said more than 95 percent of its 1997 production is hedged at an average of US$374 an ounce and most of its 1998 production is hedged at US$372 an ounce.
William is scheduled to produce over 225,000 ounces of gold at a cash cost of US$226 an ounce in 1997, the company said.
William has gold mining operations in Sweden, Brazil, Australia and Finland.
